jobs.prompt: Ticket T-8022 (atlas bug): validateTicketPaths in tools/ticket-paths.mjs (the 'likely typo' rule, ~lines 180-220) flagged tools/warm_boi_tiles.py as a typo of tools/warm_ten_mile.py and the ingest refused the WHOLE split with no override. Fix: (1) a similar-name hit on a path the ticket CREATES (it is in the ticket's own files/outputs and does not exist in the repo yet) is only a WARNING: return it in a warnings list (code 'similar-new-file', naming both paths) that the ingest prints in its report; the 'likely typo' REFUSAL stays only for read/context paths (context, tests read, deletes) that do not exist. Keep tests/scope-ingest-paths.test.mjs and tests/scope-split-guards.test.mjs passing. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/ticket-paths-new-files.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-*.test.mjs tests/scope-split-guards.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
